title: Lore pane re-test fixes (seq 243): held-width line, held classification, state-first toggle label
description:
Filed 2026-10-03 from the operator re-test of the Lore pane at dev 466dee64, which did NOT pass; routed by opum-agent as tier 1 (the hold is lifted for this one fix task only). Source: opum-doc relay ODOC-OP-2026-10-03-74 (seq 243), recorded on opum-agent OPAG-1086/OPAG-1075 and landed (opum-ai/opum-agent#2013). The LCLI-665 version bump and the paired 0.13.0 release stay HELD and are untouched by this task.

The re-test, same state in both panes: lore answered "Opened the Lore pane, opened at 80 columns; the pane kept its width." where quest answered "Opened the Quest board at 80 columns; the width is kept."

Three items, all in hooks/register.tsx:
1. DEFECT: the DEC-154 rule 3 held-width line (keptWidthLine) never renders in a real session even though dockColumns=80 is kept. Measure why before fixing, and state the cause.
2. DEFECT: the dashboard tool answer uses the NOT-held wording while a kept width holds, and it repeats the word opened. Both panes must classify the same held state the same way (seq 234); match Quest held wording.
3. UX DEFECT, ruled by opum-doc (its Article 5 call): the toggle label names the action (Normal size / Full screen), so it reads as the current state. Show the CURRENT mode as state with the key as a hint: "Normal - z for full" / "Full - z for normal" (separator U+00B7). When a width is held, the held line follows it. The pane title stays "Lore".

Deliverable: one branch and PR into dev; report the task id, PR number, head SHA and CI on that SHA to opum-agent, which opum-doc loads for the next re-test. Precedent: LCLI-675 (the DEC-154 engine-sizing fix), LCLI-674 (the measurement of the engine grant), LCLI-672 (the pty probe pattern, /private/tmp/lcli672-probe/drive.py).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The cause of the held-width line never rendering in a real session is measured and named, and after the fix a rendered pane shows "Width kept at 80 (you set it): drag the pane edge to change" while a kept 80-column dock width stands against a larger full ask - proven against the rendered pane, not only the source.

While that kept width holds, the dashboard tool answer classifies the state as held and matches Quest held wording - "Opened the Lore pane at 80 columns; the width is kept." - and no answer shape repeats the word opened.

The header shows the current mode as state with the key as a hint - "Normal · z for full" in normal mode and "Full · z for normal" in full mode - so it no longer reads as an action to take, with the held line following it when a width is held; the pane title stays "Lore".
bun test and the mod suite (bun run test:mod) pass on the landed head, and each of the three fixes is mutation-pinned: reverting it alone reddens its own test.
The change lands on dev by squash merge with every required check a completed success on the exact head SHA, and the PR head SHA is reported to opum-agent for the re-test.

implementationNotes: Started 2026-10-03. First step: measure the cause of the missing held-width line in a real engine session, using the LCLI-672 probe pattern. The 0.13.0 release stays held; this is a dev-only fix.
finalSummary: All five criteria verified at head f66b8f3d (opum-ai/lore-cli#488), green in CI run 37151351887: 13 success + promotion is manual skipped by design, all six required dev contexts among the successes. CAUSE, measured in a real pty on Claude Code 2.1.288 before any fix: the kept-width line's condition suppressed the render that spends a full ask as pre-grant by definition, and a kept pluginPanes.dockColumns beats every size request, so the request that render makes is a no-op and the engine raises no further draw -- the suppressed render was the last one, so the line never drew and the tool answer read that same suppression (pre-fix frames out-tool3/f3-z-full-1s and f4-z-full-6s: hold=0 and no line in both, six seconds apart, no redraw between). FIXES: (1) the line reads the design's own rule on every full docked draw -- within SIZE_SLACK granted, anything further off is a width the surface kept, the classification Quest's board makes of the same state (seq 234) -- and the awaitingGrant/holding state machine is gone; (2) the tool's dock short case uses that classification and Quest's wording, joined as Quest joins it so no shape repeats "opened": "Opened the Lore pane at 80 columns; the width is kept."; (3) the header's mode control shows state with the key as its hint ("Normal · z for full" / "Full · z for normal", separator U+00B7 verified by codepoint), the held line follows it, and the title stays "Lore". PROOF: post-fix pty frames show the line in the exact failing state and photograph the tool answer; mutation pins -- the line revert reddens only the kept-width test (59 pass / 1 fail), the answer revert only the tool-answer test, the label revert the two label tests; gates -- mod suite 60/60 with a clean typecheck, bun test 4921 pass / 1 skip / 1 fail (the pre-existing LCLI-645 SF1 red, control-verified on dev in the LCLI-675 record), bun run lore check 0 errors, biome and tsc clean. Operator pane state (pluginPanes, the opum-lore store) was recorded before the probes and is byte-identical after.
